header.name: Game Development & Design
header.description: This hands-on project-based course will introduce students to the fundamentals of game development & design using the Unreal 4 game engine. Topics include level design, lighting, materials, particle effects, game AI, game logic, user input mappings, audio, physics and motion. Students will learn to implement custom game logic using the Blueprints Visual Scripting system. In this course students will create an architectural visualization, a shooting gallery mini-game and a basic first person shooter. Students will be evaluated on both technical and creative ability.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to utilize and implement general game design theory and techniques

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to design and utilize custom Blueprints scripts

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to creatively design specific game elements based on topics learned in class

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Understand and implement basic AI concepts

lecture_topics: Creating and Detailing an Interior Room
Create a Key Pickup and HUD
Animating and Opening a Door in Blueprints
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: After learning to create an architectural visualization of an interior room, students will design two additional rooms to complete the space. These rooms will have interactive lighting, objects and effects. Students will create key pickup functionality in Blueprints in order to open a door and transition to a new level.

lecture_topics: Create a Destructible Mesh to Shatter Objects
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: For the second level, students will design a complete shooting gallery mini-game. Students will be expected to create simple materials, create a new level of their own design, implement a simple user interface, and create a win condition.

lecture_topics: Character Enhancements (Sprint, Rifle Zoom, Rate of Fire)
Game Objectives and Constraints, Collectible Objects & Win Condition
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students will design a battlefield, create simple character enhancements and utilize basic AI concepts to create and customize their own first person shooter.
Students will design their own side-scroller and finalize/package all 4 projects.
